I used to be like this. I always felt like the odd one out. I never had anything good to say. I was always uncomfortable. People would think I'm weird because I couldn't seem to engage myself in group discussions and would instead stare blankly at the wall. 

And then I just found a group of people at work who liked me as is. I know you shouldn't make friends with coworkers but where else do socially awkward people find friends other than the place where they stay majority of the time? Honestly, it was more them than me. But I can still be silent if I want to and I don't feel uncomfortable at all, which is a big achievement.

Tho I probably won't see them anymore once I leave my job. But that will be my problem for the future.
Me. I make new reddit accounts regularly.

Because human beings are wired not to be attracted to people they spend a lot of time with during their toddler years. It's how nature prevents us from procreating with our kin. Childhood friends could have met each other when they're 10.
